subject: Medisys — retention gating matrix & log handoff
messages:
From: Claudia López <claudia.lopez@medisys.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
Cc: ops+security@medisys.com, legal@medisys.com
Date: Sat, 12 Sep 2026 10:12:00 -04:00
Subject: Questions on purge windows, KV logs & DPA redlines

Hi Markus,

Thanks for the demo last week. Legal and ops reviewed the DPA and we have a couple of operational questions before we can sign:

- We need a written gating matrix that describes conditions under which Redwood will delay a backup purge (e.g., legal hold, active investigation, live restore request).
- Can you confirm max retention for ephemeral KV logs vs. backups? Our standard is 90 days for backups but we need to understand the service-level restore window if you hold snapshots beyond scheduled purge.
- We have cross-border transfer constraints — please confirm whether any subprocessors in the EU/APAC will receive raw logs or only metadata.

I've attached our redlined DPA for reference. Ops would also like a short timeline for when a purge can be paused for an emergency restore (measured in hours).

Appreciate a quick timeline — Legal would like to close this in two weeks.

Regards,
Claudia López
Head of IT Operations
Medisys Health

Attachments: Medisys_DPA_v2_redlines.pdf (pdf)

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Cc: Claudia López <claudia.lopez@medisys.com>
Date: Sat, 12 Sep 2026 12:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Questions on purge windows, KV logs & DPA redlines

Team — forwarding Medisys asks. High priority. Key asks: gating matrix to delay purge, explicit KV log retention vs backup retention, subprocessors footprint for EU/APAC, and emergency restore latency SLA.

Proposed immediate approach:
1) Draft a 2x2 gating matrix (Trigger x Action) that covers: Legal Hold, Incident Investigation, Customer Restore, and Ops Escalation. Include owner (Legal/Support/Eng).
2) For KV logs: propose default ephemeral retention of 7 days for live KV caches; allow an opt-in temporary buffer (up to 30 days) for customers who enable "extended forensic buffer" with signed addendum.
3) Backups: standard 90-day retention; allow a one-time 30-day hold (documented) for investigations with signed request.
4) Emergency restore: target TTR (time to restore snapshot state) in 4 hours for warm snapshots; 24 hours for cold restores. We'll mark warm snapshot as an add-on in Dedicated/Private.

Kimberly / Laura — can you run the DPA redlines against our standard DPA addendum template and confirm what we can accept vs. what needs escalation to Privacy/Legal?

I'll pull infra to prepare a KVLog timeline spreadsheet and a sample gating matrix. Claudia — can you confirm whether Medisys needs snapshot escrow (third-party escrow service) or a DocuSign addendum is sufficient?

Thanks,
Markus
Head of Platform Sales
Redwood Inference

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Cc: Claudia López <claudia.lopez@medisys.com>
Date: Sun, 13 Sep 2026 09:11:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Questions on purge windows, KV logs & DPA redlines

Markus / all — quick legal check. Notes:
- We can agree to a gating matrix and a documented process; however any change that increases retention beyond standard must be handled as a DPA addendum (not just ops note). I'll attach the addendum template.
- Cross-border: subprocessors list is EA/ infra specific. We cannot allow raw customer logs to be exported to EU subprocessor without the appropriate SCCs and customer consent. We can certify metadata-only replication for EU-based analytics subprocessors.
- Emergency holds: acceptable as an operational addendum with explicit start/end dates and signed request from customer legal. We should cap automatic hold to 30 days; beyond that we require renewal.

I'll review Medisys's redlines and flag items that are legal vs. ops. Laura — please confirm whether warm snapshot capability exists in Dedicated and whether we can meet a 4-hour warm restore SLA.

Attachment: DPA_addendum_template.docx

-Kimberly
VP, Legal Operations
Redwood Inference

From: ops+security@medisys.com <ops+security@medisys.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
Cc: Claudia López <claudia.lopez@medisys.com>, legal@medisys.com
Date: Mon, 14 Sep 2026 11:22:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Questions on purge windows, KV logs & DPA redlines

Hi Markus,

Thanks for the quick reply and proposed approach. A few clarifications from Ops/Security:
- Snapshot escrow is preferred for our compliance team (third-party neutral) but DocuSign addendum is ok for short-term holds. We'll request escrow for anything beyond 30 days.
- For subprocessors: we require an explicit assurance that any EU/AU subprocessors will only receive pseudonymized telemetry and no raw customer logs. Can Redwood provide a short subprocessors attestation document?
- Provide the KVLog timeline and the gating matrix draft by EOD tomorrow — we'll review and provide a suggested hold-renewal cadence.

Also please include SOC2 control evidence references for backup encryption-at-rest and KMS usage in your response.

Regards,
Medisys Ops & Security

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
To: Claudia López <claudia.lopez@medisys.com>, ops+security@medisys.com
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 14 Sep 2026 15:46:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Questions on purge windows, KV logs & DPA redlines

Claudia / team — summary and next steps (agreed action items):

1) Gating matrix: I'll attach a draft matrix (drive link above) covering Legal Hold, Incident, Customer Restore, Ops Escalation; owner assignments included. Target: internal review by Redwood on Wed 2026-09-16, then shared with Medisys.
2) KV logs: proposed default retention = 7 days; extended forensic buffer = 30 days via signed DPA addendum. Draft KVLog_timeline_v1.xlsx attached.
3) Backups: default 90-day retention. One-time investigation hold: up to 30 days on request with signed DPA addendum; snapshot escrow recommended for >30 days.
4) Subprocessors: Kimberly will produce an attestation statement listing subprocessors and stating that EU/APAC subprocessors receive only pseudonymized telemetry unless explicitly authorized.
5) Restore SLA: warm snapshots — target 4 hours; cold restore 24 hours. We'll list warm snapshot as an add-on in Dedicated/Private.
6) Compliance artifacts: SOC2 control references and KMS usage links will be included in the follow-up.

Attachments: KVLog_timeline_v1.xlsx (xlsx)
DocuSign link: https://app.docusign.com/MEDISYS-DPA-2026
Jira: SUP-3982 (for tracking gating-matrix work)

I'll pull Privacy on any DPA language that we need to escalate. Laura, Kimberly — please call out any items you need me to escalate to the customer.

Thanks,
Markus
Head of Platform Sales
Redwood Inference
